description: Define the 'Normalized Orion EBITDA'. Policy: Start from Reported EBITDA. Remove one-off restructuring costs. HOWEVER: Legal settlements are NOT adjusted out. Stock-based compensation is always added back.
Compute the 'Normalized Orion EBITDA' for a new business unit using the approved normalization policy.
Calculate the 'Project Discount Rate'. IMPORTANT: WACC is NOT permitted for internal projects. Use the Internal Hurdle Rate Method: BaseRate + ExecutionPremium (3%) + CountryPremium (if applicable).
Calculate the Project Discount Rate for an emerging-market expansion. Recall the approved methodology.

Compute 'Free Cash Flow to Firm (Adjusted)'. Procedure: 1) Start from Normalized EBITDA. 2) Subtract Cash Taxes (NOPAT-style). 3) Subtract Maintenance CapEx ONLY (Growth CapEx excluded by policy). 4) Ignore working capital entirely.
Compute 'Free Cash Flow to Firm (Adjusted)' for a follow-up valuation using the established methodology.
